title: Questions 1
subtitle: Порядок слов в вопросе, who/what как подлежащее, отрицательные вопросы

theory.text: В вопросе подлежащее стоит после первого (вспомогательного) глагола: Kate will be here. → Will Kate be here? Is Tom working today? (не Is working Tom). When was this bridge built?
В Present и Past Simple нужен do/does/did, а основной глагол — в начальной форме: Where do your parents live? Why did you sell your car? (не Why did you sold).

head: who/what — дополнение
who/what — подлежащее
rows: Anna called somebody. → Who did Anna call?

items: Если who/what/which/how many — подлежащее, do/does/did не нужен: What happened? Which bus goes to the centre?
Предлог обычно в конце: Who are you waiting for? What are you thinking about? What was the weather like?

theory.text: Отрицательные вопросы выражают удивление или ожидание согласия: Didn't you hear the phone? — Разве ты не слышал телефон? С why: Why don't we go out? Why wasn't Dan at school?
Русские часто строят вопрос без перестановки: Why you didn't come? Правильно: Why didn't you come? И помните: «Кто это сделал?» — Who did it?, а не Who did do it?

en: Is Kate going to be here tomorrow?
Have you been waiting for a long time?
Did you wait for a long time?
When did they build this bridge?
What time does the shop close?
What time does the store close?
Why did you sell your car?
What did Paul say to you?
How many people came to the meeting?
Where does your wife come from?

items.ru: С кем вы разговаривали вчера вечером?
en: Who were you talking to last night?
Who were you speaking to last night?
Who did you talk to last night?
Who did you speak to last night?
Who were you talking to yesterday evening?
Who did you talk to yesterday evening?
What was the weather like in Rome?
How was the weather in Rome?

items.ru: Почему бы нам не пойти в кино?
en: Why don't we go to the cinema?
Why don't we go to the movies?
Why don't we go to the pictures?

items.ru: Почему Дэна вчера не было в школе?
en: Why wasn't Dan at school yesterday?
Why wasn't Dan in school yesterday?

items.ru: Почему ты не пришёл на вечеринку?
en: Why didn't you come to the party?
